title: PAIR: Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting for Adaptive Rollout Allocation in RLVR
abstract: arXiv:2608.11368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) spends most of its compute generating groups of long reasoning trajectories. Recent allocators reduce this cost by assigning budgets to prompts, rollouts, or tokens according to a pointwise notion of difficulty or utility. We identify a statistical mismatch: the unclipped leave-one-out group-relative score gradient is not a sum of independent point contributions, but a second-order U-statistic over pairs of rollouts. Completing one rollout therefore reveals contrast with every other completed rollout, and adaptive endpoint selection changes which pair terms are observable. We introduce PAIR (Pairwise-Aware Inclusion Reweighting), which treats short rollout prefixes as vertices and pair-gradient terms as edges of a contrast graph. translated_title: PAIR：面向成对感知的包含重加权方法用于RLVR中的自适应展开分配
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.11368v1 公告类型：新 摘要：具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）大部分计算资源用于生成长推理轨迹组。最近的分配器通过根据点式难度或效用概念为提示、展开或令牌分配预算来降低此成本。我们发现了一个统计上的不匹配：未裁剪的留一法组相对得分梯度不是独立点贡献的总和，而是展开对上的二阶U统计量。因此，完成一个展开会揭示与每个其他已完成展开的对比，而自适应端点选择会改变哪些对项是可观察的。我们引入了PAIR（成对感知包含重加权），它将短展开前缀视为顶点，将对梯度项视为对比图的边。一个仅基于前缀的预测器估计正确性和剩余令牌成本；一个凸设计在期望后缀条件下选择正延续概率。
tldr: 本论文提出PAIR方法，通过将RLVR中的展开分配问题建模为成对对比图，并利用前缀预测和凸优化实现自适应预算分配，解决了点式分配导致的统计失配问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PAIR, which models rollout allocation in RLVR as a pairwise contrast graph and leverages prefix prediction with convex optimization for adaptive budgeting, addressing the statistical mismatch of pointwise allocation.
